en.name: Market Entry Cohort 8
en.description: Twelve weeks of structured market briefings, partner discovery, and pitch preparation for companies ready to enter China or Latin America.
en.detailSubtitle: A guided cohort for scale-ups and established companies preparing for a real market entry — not generic research.
en.metaTitle: Market Entry Cohort 8 | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: Apply to Market Entry Cohort 8 — twelve weeks of market briefings, partner discovery, and pitch preparation for cross-border expansion.
en.bodyHtml:
Cohort 8 helps companies move from market interest to a concrete entry plan. Each week pairs sector briefings with operator working sessions, partner introductions, and structured feedback on positioning.

Selected teams leave with a prioritized partner shortlist, a localized pitch, and a defined commercial next step.

What's included

  • Sector and city readiness briefings.
  • Partner and customer discovery sessions.
  • Localized pitch and application support.
  • Direct introductions to ecosystem operators.

br.name: Cohort 8 — Entrada em Mercado
br.description: Doze semanas de briefings de mercado, descoberta de parceiros e preparacao de pitch para empresas prontas para entrar na China ou na America Latina.
br.detailSubtitle: Uma turma guiada para scale-ups e empresas estabelecidas preparando uma entrada real em mercado — sem pesquisa generica.
br.metaTitle: Cohort 8 — Entrada em Mercado | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Aplique para a Cohort 8 — doze semanas de briefings, descoberta de parceiros e preparacao de pitch para expansao cross-border.
br.bodyHtml:
A Cohort 8 ajuda empresas a sair do interesse em mercado para um plano concreto de entrada. Cada semana combina briefings setoriais com sessoes operacionais, apresentacoes de parceiros e feedback estruturado de posicionamento.

Times selecionados saem com shortlist priorizada de parceiros, pitch localizado e proximo passo comercial definido.

O que esta incluido

  • Briefings de prontidao por setor e cidade.
  • Sessoes de descoberta de parceiros e clientes.
  • Apoio a pitch e submissao localizada.
  • Apresentacoes diretas a operadores do ecossistema.

cn.name: 市场进入第八期
cn.description: 为准备进入中国或拉美的企业提供为期 12 周的结构化市场简报、伙伴对接和路演准备。
cn.detailSubtitle: 面向已经具备牵引力、准备真实进入市场的成长型企业和成熟公司——不只是泛泛调研。
cn.metaTitle: 市场进入第八期 | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 申请市场进入第八期——12 周的市场简报、伙伴对接与路演准备，助力跨境扩张。
cn.bodyHtml:
第八期帮助企业从市场兴趣过渡到具体的进入计划。每周将行业简报与运营工作坊、合作伙伴介绍以及定位反馈结合在一起。

入选团队将带走优先级合作伙伴名单、本地化路演材料以及明确的商业下一步。

包含内容

  • 行业与城市就绪简报。
  • 合作伙伴与客户发现会谈。
  • 本地化路演与提案支持。
  • 直接对接生态运营者。
